# Scenario 1: HalfBinomialLoss(); y_true=1.0; raw=-1e3; calls loss.gradient(raw), loss.gradient_hessian(raw), loss.loss_gradient(raw)
try:
    loss_obj = HalfBinomialLoss()
    y_true = np.array([1.0])
    raw = np.array([-1e3])
    
    gradient_result = loss_obj.gradient(y_true, raw)
    gradient_hessian_result = loss_obj.gradient_hessian(y_true, raw)
    loss_gradient_result = loss_obj.loss_gradient(y_true, raw)
    
    probe("HalfBinomialLoss(); y_true=1.0; raw=-1e3; calls loss.gradient(raw), loss.gradient_hessian(raw), loss.loss_gradient(raw)", {
        "gradient": gradient_result,
        "gradient_hessian": gradient_hessian_result,
        "loss_gradient": loss_gradient_result
    })

    probe_exception("HalfBinomialLoss(); y_true=1.0; raw=-1e3; calls loss.gradient(raw), loss.gradient_hessian(raw), loss.loss_gradient(raw)", e)
